description: The Klusvang bouwmonitor: a frozen monthly count of building-permit notices in the Netherlands, by work type and province, with a ranking of municipalities (optionally for one work type or one province). Without month: the latest closed month. Closed months never change. Counts only.

month.description: YYYY-MM. Default: the latest closed month.

province.description: Rank only the municipalities of this province.

work_type.description: Rank municipalities by this work type.

name: bouwmonitor_month
title: Klusvang bouwmonitor: one closed month
